bigIdeas.en: Mixed numbers and decimal numbers represent quantities that can be decomposed into parts and wholes.
bigIdeas.zh: 带分数和小数表示的数量，可以拆成整的部分和零头部分。

bigIdeas.en: Computational fluency and flexibility with numbers extend to operations with whole numbers and decimals.
bigIdeas.zh: 运算的熟练和灵活，扩展到整数和小数的运算。

bigIdeas.en: Linear relations can be identified and represented using expressions with variables and line graphs and can be used to form generalizations.
bigIdeas.zh: 线性关系可以用含变量的式子和折线图来识别和表示，并由此归纳出一般规律。

bigIdeas.en: Properties of objects and shapes can be described, measured, and compared using volume, area, perimeter, and angles.
bigIdeas.zh: 物体和图形的特性，可以用体积、面积、周长和角来描述、测量和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Data from the results of an experiment can be used to predict the theoretical probability of an event and to compare and interpret.
bigIdeas.zh: 实验结果的数据可以用来预测事件的理论可能性，并进行比较和解读。
